summary: GI round 4, package PE: routing extent vocabulary (synthesis E2; plan Wave 1 PE). New cues.REACHED_BEFORE_ROUTING = installed cues.REACHED_BEFORE with 'steered' and 'navigated' added to its reach verbs, read ONLY by detect._landmarks (both of its REACHED_BEFORE reads: the reach and the cell-cut test), through new _pe_ helpers. cues.REACHED_BEFORE itself and every constant context.py or sections.py reads stay byte-identical, so the request side cannot move. A reach read only by a routing-only verb counts only under fail-closed guards (each can only give back installed behaviour): the landmark lies at or beyond the depth the family calls for (cecum for the lower tract; _expected_upper_depth for the upper), no denial governs the verb ('could not be steered', 'was not', 'never', 'unable to', 'failed to', a negation or an attempt word between the verb and the landmark), no falling-short adverb (cues._FALLING_SHORT), and the instrument steered is an endoscope (a scope word before the verb in the clause window or as its object, never an accessory: guidewire, catheter, balloon, dilator, stent, probe, ...).

Its stomach is reached by the installed form ('introduced ... through the'), its pylorus is reached by neither form (the comma after 'stomach'), and its duodenum is blocked by cues.NOT_REACHED_BEFORE before any reach is read; it stays 43235 selected/ready with its incompleteness signal and extent 'incomplete: stomach'. Every other row has no 'steered'/'navigated' and cannot move.

an accessory steered or navigated is no endoscope reach (read as installed): a guidewire navigated through the pylorus into the duodenum, a balloon steered into the duodenal bulb, a catheter navigated to the cecum

a routing-only verb never reads a landmark short of the family's endpoint (read as installed, so no new 'incomplete: X'): steered into the esophagus, steered into the stomach, navigated into the rectum, navigated to the hepatic flexure

rules.copy_guards: A reach read only by a routing-only verb ('steered', 'navigated') counts only inside today's procedure narrative, read by the same shared copy guards as package PI's S1 and E1 (detect.in_todays_narrative; see pi.json amendment_20261101_cycle1 'todays_narrative'): no foreign block opened before it (an attachment or copy heading, a heading dated another day, a sign-off line, a statement that a copy follows), a governing heading-like line within 200 lines / 20,000 characters that names no other record or occasion, no education, no facility below the head's fields, no other date and is no history, plan or indication heading, a block with no other date and no sign-off, a sentence with no generalisation, not under another occurrence (sections.under_another_occurrence, read there now instead of in _pe_routing_reach's last line) and not beyond heading reach (sections.beyond_heading_reach). Unlike S1 and E1, PE does not require the strong head: the binding rule for PE asks for routing's copy guards, and PE's release is a routing reach the installed verbs already read the same way.
